description: Waterways of Virgin Islands, U.S. is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Water features across the region: rivers, streams, canals, lakes, ponds, and water bodies tagged with waterway, water, or natural=water. Useful for flood-risk modelling, watershed analysis, and environmental basemap context. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. Coverage: Virgin Islands, U.S.. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are geodata, hydrology, rivers. It offers 11 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, HTML, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
